description: Remove a term from its project for good — it cannot be undone or restored, so do it only when the person asked for this very term to be deleted; confirm the name with them first. To turn down a PROPOSED term use set_term with state 'rejected' instead — a rejected term is remembered and not proposed again; a deleted one may be found and proposed anew. Members of the project who may write only.
